body:
Problems are numerous actually...

After logging out of Homarr (using OIDC here) and calling the direct URL for a public board, I do receive it. Should I reload the page, the content of the board disappears.

Often, here and there, I receive a generic error message saying

`Application error: a client-side exception has occurred while loading portal.jblan.ca (see the browser console for more information).
`

So far, I have been unable to use Homarr v1x. V0.15 was so great...
@oben01 is this only a helm problem? Because I can both edit bookmarks and notebook in the latest version (1.21.0)

Still does not work.

You can **_edit_** but changes are never saved. Do some edits, log out and back in and edits are gone.

Do a public board, load it as anonymous user and you may see the content once. If you do, just reload the page and it will be gone.

Still not working with v1.22. Stranger, I did an helm uninstall / helm install and Homarr came back online with the mods I tried to do with v1.21.

But again, change anything in a note and reload to see your changes gone. Load as anonymous and force reload the page to see it empty again.
Can you do a screencapture of it?

This seems like a rather unique error to me, can you make a screenshot of the dev console as well? I don't quite understand how the lines correspond to eachother

That error happened when reloading the public dashboard and receiving the blank screen. There are no software error when editing a note, saving it and reaching the page again to be served the default one instead of the modified one. I think the non-functional notes and bookmarks are much more important than the reloading receiving a blank page.

Still, I will once again re-install Homarr and get you a copy of the console for that blank page but working bookmarks and notes are of much higher importance.
I'm sorry, but sadly I'm unable to reproduce this bug in any way. Also I don't see what could be the reason that it should not work. Maybe I can try to find the issue on @oben01 setup later
If you PM on discord, I can show you live

@Meierschlumpf I just upgrade the test instance to latest version. you still get access to it.
Let me know if u need some logs from the cluster or from the database

Observations:

- Change a value on the notebook.
- Press "Save".
- Navigate to another page, such as Settings for Keys board.
- Return to the board, the updated value does not appear to be saved.
- However, if you refresh the page, the value is displayed correctly, indicating that it was successfully saved to the database.
Any progress on this one ?

I will try it next weekend for sure. Thanks.
